reply.diagnosis: blocks.0.ln1.weight[13] is exactly 0.000. Every other gain in that LayerNorm sits between about 0.71 and 0.88, so this one was almost certainly zeroed by the damage. With a zero gain, feature 13 never reaches the first attention layer, and pos.weight[1] has its largest value (+1.99) in that dimension. Losing it would blur which operand digit attention picks up. That fits the errors: most are off by one in the ones digit or the tens digit, which looks like dropped carries or slightly wrong digit sums.
reply.expected_effect: Setting the gain back to a typical value (0.79) should restore the missing feature to first-layer attention. Many of the off-by-one ones-digit and carry errors should then be fixed, and the practice score should rise from 83.3% toward the original ~99%.
